name: Atlantic Salmon Side, per lb
description: This Atlantic Salmon Side from ALDI is fresh and never frozen for maximum flavor. The tender salmon is harvested so you can feel good about your seafood choice. Toss it on the grill with your favorite marinade for a tasty surf and turf, or try pan-searing it with rosemary and lemon for a classic dinner.

name: Salmon with Mediterranean Herb
description: Take the guesswork out of tonight's dinner with this Salmon with Mediterranean Herbs from ALDI! The fresh, never frozen salmon is topped with a complex Mediterranean herb blend for a burst of flavor in every bite. Team yours with steamed veggies, fluffy rice, and a squeeze of fresh lemon for the perfect meal!

name: Steelhead Trout
description: This fresh Steelhead Trout from ALDI is sure to become your family's new favorite! The tender fish is perfectly flaky and grills up beautifully. Coat the fillets in garlic butter before grilling to enhance the fish's flavor, then serve with fluffy rice, roasted veggies, or a creamy pasta for a delicious dinner everyone will love.

name: Tilapia Fillets, per lb
description: ALDI's fresh tilapia fillets take the guesswork out of dinner. The fish has a mild taste that's perfect for pairing with zesty sauces, bold spice rubs, or a veggie medley. Just grill, bake, or pan-sear the fresh, never frozen tilapia for a delicious meal in minutes!

name: Cedar Plank Salmon
description: Make tonight's dinner a breeze with this Atlantic Salmon Cedar Plank Salmon! The fresh, never frozen fish comes on a cedar plank and is perfectly flaky and packed with flavor. Team yours with fluffy rice, a sprig of rosemary, and a squeeze of lemon for a refreshing and tasty meal!

name: Wild Caught Sockeye Salmon
description: Put a sophisticated spin on your next date night at home with this Wild Caught Sockeye Salmon from ALDI! The fresh, never frozen sockeye salmon portion is flaky and tender, perfect for searing on your stovetop. Team yours with a squeeze of bright lemon and a sprinkle of fresh, flavorful herbs for a delicious dinner!

name: Atlantic Salmon Portions, per lb
description: Make this fresh Atlantic Salmon from ALDI the star of your next dinner party. The tender fish is delicious when pan-seared with a robust spice blend. Team it with fluffy rice, a roasted veggie medley, or creamy pasta for the perfect pairing everyone will love.

name: Fresh Stuffed Atlantic Salmon, 16 oz
description: Elevate your household seafood staples with this delicious Stuffed Atlantic Salmon from ALDI. Filled with premium seafood, each bite of the Atlantic salmon is tender, flavorful, and perfectly flaky. It's fresh, never frozen & BAP certified, so you can feel good about making this choice for your family.
